structured.rankingRationale: Top candidates combine a verified future Toronto date and venue with a plausible delegate, speaker, executive, side-meeting or reception mechanism. Campus and MTCC events with no published hotel block rank above events already contracted to Hilton, Sheraton or Chelsea; committed venues remain valuable only as future-capture or overflow intelligence.

notesForDeepResearch: Verify current hotel operating status, meeting-room configuration and catering before any outreach claim.
For each accepted event, identify the event owner, planner/PCO, housing contact and participant booking model.
Prioritize campus/MTCC events with unannounced lodging; approach committed hotel events only for future edition, overflow or ancillary needs.
materialUncertainties: No candidate has a published room block for the Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown.
Attendance and peak rooms are generally not published in the cited evidence; the few published attendance figures are not room-night forecasts.
Several events have confirmed competing hotels or accommodation venues; those are future-capture/overflow signals, not current open inventory.
The hotel restaurant/lounge and current catering operating status require separate verification.

result.text: Structured discovery of 15 verified future Toronto event opportunities for the Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown, emphasizing realistic delegate, speaker, side-meeting, overflow and future-capture roles rather than unsupported room-block assumptions.
